scope: Actual HDRP depth/normal readback versus current uploaded mesh ray intersections at sampled interior/near-edge pixels. Historical Empty silhouettes also test selected stale-depth pixels. A former silhouette with hasExpectedSectionSurface=false has no current section ray hit: PASS_FORMER_SURFACE_ABSENT means only that finite actual depth lies more than 1 mm behind the old surface; current background depth/normal agreement is NOT_VALIDATED and does not increment matchedDepth/matchedNormals. Other scene occluders are classified separately. A disagreement within 1/128 pixel of a projected triangle edge is NOT_VALIDATED_RASTER_BOUNDARY, never a passing normal/depth match; it bounds subpixel raster coverage ambiguity. This does not validate every pixel, final color, shadows, reflections, or temporal history.
isolatedReadbackDepthMutation: PASS_DETECTED: FAIL_POSSIBLE_STALE_DEPTH; isolated CPU mutation of one actual GPU-readback depth pixel; no GPU render fault was injected; original pixels and baseline probes were preserved
